fields.description: Identity is inherited from the linked guest, not duplicated here. Role (for alert notification gating) is resolved live from the guest's own server at alert time, not cached on this doc — Proxmox Guest itself follows the same practice.
fields.label: Proxmox Guest

fields.description: Time of the last successful SSH poll.
fields.label: Last Seen

fields.description: Computed: last_seen within Host Monitor Settings' Heartbeat Timeout. Set on every successful poll, and cleared by the heartbeat watchdog when polls stop succeeding.
fields.label: Is Online

fields.description: OR across this host's benches of orphan_critical_streak reaching Confirmation Checks — stable alert reference for Worker Degraded, since Frappe Worker Health Log itself is append-only and can't be one.
fields.label: Worker Health Critical

fields.description: OR across this host's benches of failed_job_critical_streak reaching Confirmation Checks — stable alert reference for Failed Job Threshold, same reasoning as Worker Health Critical.
fields.label: Failed Job Critical

fields.description: OR across this host's benches of long_running_job_critical_streak reaching Confirmation Checks — stable alert reference for Long Running Job, same reasoning as Worker Health Critical.
fields.label: Long Running Job Critical

fields.description: Resource Metric Log's load_critical_streak reaching Confirmation Checks — stable alert reference for High Load Average, since Resource Metric Log itself is append-only and can't be one.
fields.label: Load Average Critical

fields.description: Resource Metric Log's swap_critical_streak reaching Confirmation Checks — stable alert reference for High Swap Usage, same reasoning as Load Average Critical.
fields.label: Swap Critical

fields.description: Leave empty to use Host Monitor Settings → Default Expected Services. Add rows here only to add/remove services for this specific host.
fields.label: Expected Services (override)

fields.description: Site inventory read from the host's bench — informational only, not monitored. Fully replaced on every poll.
fields.label: Hosted Sites

fields.description: Latest scheduler heartbeat read from the host, across all benches on it.
fields.label: Scheduler Last Run
SSH Target
fields.description: Warpgate target name, or hostname/IP in Direct mode. Leave empty to use the guest's IP address.

fields.label: SSH User
fields.description: Direct mode only. Empty uses SSH Settings' default user.

fields.label: Bench Path
fields.description: Absolute path of the Frappe bench on this host, e.g. /home/frappe/frappe-bench. Leave empty for hosts without a bench.

fields.label: Pinned Host Key
fields.description: Direct mode only. Stored on first connection; a change blocks polling until reset.

fields.label: Last Poll Result
fields.description: ok, or the reason the last poll failed (auth, timeout, hostkey, refused, collector, config).
